g.text: The mesh is treated as a weighted graph in which an edge is cheap to traverse where the force density is high and where the path

g.text: does not turn. Dijkstra then returns the dominant tensile load paths, and the chains it finds are kept only where they reach a

g.text: support — a chain ends on an already-retained cable for nothing, or on the boundary at the price of a new anchor.
